name: Break the Pattern (General)
body:
You have happy accidents even when there is a minimal amount of chaos to take advantage of.

Prerequisite(s): Improbable class feature (twist the pattern)

Benefit(s): When you use your twist the pattern special ability and take a 10, roll 1d20 and take the higher result. When you take a 20 roll a d20 and add the luck bonus to the skill check as listed below.
